t: The Sneaky setting determines which side of the adjacent inventory the card attempts to operate on.$(br2)For example, a furnace accepts items from the 'Top Side' of the block. If the node is on a side of the furnace, set the sneaky mode of the insert card to 'Up'.
按面连接设置决定物流卡会对毗邻存储空间的哪一面交互。$(br2)例如，熔炉从其“上面”接受待烧炼的物品。若节点在熔炉的侧面，再将按面连接设置为“上”，
This card will now attempt to insert items into the 'top' side of the furnace.$(br2)Another card can be set to 'Sneaky Down' to insert fuel into the bottom of the furnace.
该卡便会将物品从熔炉的“上面”存入熔炉。$(br2)另一张卡可将按面连接设置为“下”以从熔炉下方输入燃料。
